event.description:
# Yeti Gaming Online Regional Announcements NOW WITH ENTRY PRIZING  If Registering through Omni, please make sure you join the server and follow the proper channels to join!

**Yeti Gaming is excited to announce our second Online Regional Championship! on April 21st!**

**ALL REGIONS ARE WELCOME!** 
 __REGISTER HERE:__ $25
https://www.paypal.com/instantcommerce/checkout/FF6UR73FUNPLN

If you cannot pay via Paypal, please DM me and we will work out an alternate form of payment.

# After Sign Up 
All Paid Participants must DM @andyk the following:
- Omnidex ID #
- Screenshot of your Payment / Order Number

*Failure to do so will restrict your entry to the event*

# Regional Date & Times
- All timestamps are RELATIVE to **YOUR** Timezone

Check-In Open: <t:1711767600:F> | <t:1711767600:R>
Check-In Close: <t:1711767600:F> | <t:1711767600:R>
Round 1 Start Time: <t:1713715200:F> | <t:1713715200:R>

Decklists must be submitted before <t:1713713400:F> | <t:1713713400:R>
*Failure to submit your decklist on time will restrict your entry to the event*

# Prizing

Entry Prizing:
-**1 Sapphire Pack**
-3 ALC Silver Event Packs
-3 ALC Booster Packs

**Top 16 Prizes**
(Could reduce to top 8 or increase to top 32 depending on attendance)
- Finalist Playmat
- ALC Regional Invite Prize Card (For Nationals 2025)
- 6 ALC Booster Packs
- 6 ALC Gold Event Packs
- 3 Sapphire Packs

**Top 8 Prizes**
(Could reduce to top 4 or increase to top 8 depending on attendance)
-Finalist Playmat
- ALC Regional Invite Prize Card (For Nationals 2025)
-12 ALC Booster Packs
-10 ALC Gold Event Packs
-4 Sapphire Packs

**First Place**
-All above Top 8 Prizing
- Regional Champion Playmat
-8 Additional Sapphire Packs (12 total)

If you have any questions please ask! @everyone
